correctness.rationale: For a smooth cubic surface over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, the 27 line classes E_i, L_ij=H−E_i−E_j, Q_i=2H−Σ_{j≠i}E_j and 45 tritangent triples all have sum −K. From 15 T_ij (i<j), five T_j1, and one perfect-matching triple, elementary integral eliminations yield Z[H,E_1,...,E_6]/(3H−ΣE_i), which is torsion-free rank six. Every remaining tritangent becomes zero, so the selected 21 relations span all 45; Pic(S)/Z[-K] identifies with the E6 weight lattice by unimodular intersection pairing and primitive root sublattice. Independent full 27×45 integral matrix construction gives Smith diagonal 1^21,0^6 and selected 21×21 row minor determinant +1, confirming saturation and minimum 21. The W(E6) natural line/triple action is compatible with quotient. This claims neither new cubic surface classification nor arithmetic descent.
